mistake.headline:
Eyes on the floor.
Back rounds over.
mistake.body: Look at the ground and you're naturally in bad posture. A rounded back is the biggest reason I see guys get hurt deadlifting.

image.label: real
image.alt: Dan at the bottom of a kettlebell deadlift, looking up at the sky, back flat

fix.headline:
Look at
the sky.
fix.body: Look at the ceiling, or the sky if you're outside. When you're looking up, [em]you can't really have bad posture.[/em]

image.label: real
image.alt: Dan standing tall with the kettlebell, eyes up

cues.title: 3 cues
cues.subtitle: for a safer deadlift
items: Eyes on the ceiling or the sky the whole rep.
Bend your legs, not your back.
Use it most when you're tired. That's when posture slips.

blocks.title: Send it
blocks.text: to the guy who deadlifts staring at his shoes.

cta.follow: One fix a week, filmed on me.
